chunks: The Shaykh informed me, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād, from al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad, from more than one person, from Abān, from a man, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
Regarding a man who dies with a group of people at sea, he said: “He is given ghusl, shrouded, salat is performed over him, he is weighted down, and he is cast into the sea.”

key_terms.الْبَحْرِ: The sea, indicating the setting of death and disposal.
key_terms.يُثَقَّلُ: He is weighted down so the body will sink.
key_terms.يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ: The funeral salat is performed over him.
key_terms.يُغَسَّلُ: He is given ghusl (ritual washing of the deceased).
key_terms.يُكَفَّنُ: He is shrouded in burial cloth.

ai.seo_question: How should a deceased Muslim be buried if he dies at sea according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for handling the body of a deceased person who dies at sea. It states that the deceased should be given ghusl, shrouded, prayed over, then weighted and committed to the sea, preserving the rites of the dead as much as possible in such circumstances.
